name: OmaGAWD
author: David
description: Winamp soul. Omarchy fit. Badass llama dance moves. Jellyfin, local music and worldwide radio in a compact themed player. Real frequency spectrum, keyboard control, Jellyfin-hosted and on-device playlists, and recently played albums/stations. Gapless music, optional live loudness normalization, a native Local Music manager with drag-and-drop and desktop file pickers, and clear live-radio status. Discover stations and save favourites. Settings includes playback options, sources, updates and shortcuts.

barWidget.description: Llama button for Jellyfin, local music and live radio
